756730101.text: Looks like our colorist Ashas are very much satisfied now.

756730102.text: Another challenge completed for our wondrous Ashas!

756730104.text: Is this Asha here inspired to start another artwork already?

756730107.text: #Ah, look at all the treasure it's left behind... {NICKNAME} and Paimon, the two of you should have it! For all the hard work you've put in!

756730108.text: Maybe the next time we come by, we'll be able to see the colorist Asha's masterpiece.

756730109.text: Just imagine what kind of work it would be! Especially when even the regular Ashas are already capable of coming up with such beautiful colors.

756730110.text: Paimon can't wait to see what the colorist Ashas will create! Maybe they'll come up with something... beyond what words can describe.

756730111.text: Maybe the colors of Phlogiston, the moon, or the depths of the starry sky?

756730112.text: Yeah, that's exactly how it should be! If we come across a creature in some kind of trouble during our adventures, we should do everything we can to help it...

756730113.text: Mm-hmm! Who knows? Maybe one day we'll receive some unexpected rewards!
